records.claim: Bulgaria requires a Type D long-stay visa for study programmes exceeding 90 days. An admission letter from a Bulgarian state-accredited university is required as part of the visa application. Bulgaria joined the Schengen Area on 1 January 2024 (air/sea) and 1 January 2025 (land borders).
records.methodology: Review of Bulgarian Ministry of Foreign Affairs visa information page. Confirmed Type D visa requirement for long-stay study. Schengen accession dates confirmed from official EU sources.

records.claim: Croatia requires a Type D long-stay visa for study programmes exceeding 90 days. An admission letter from a Croatian accredited university is required. Croatia joined the Schengen Area on 1 January 2023.
records.methodology: Review of Croatian Ministry of the Interior immigration pages. Confirmed Type D visa requirement for long-stay study. Schengen accession date confirmed from official EU sources.

records.claim: Guyana issues a 2-year renewable work permit for self-employed and freelance workers. Requirements include proof of professional qualification, a business plan or client contracts, police clearance, and a medical certificate. Official processing takes 4-8 weeks. Official fees are GYD 50,000-100,000.
records.methodology: Review of Guyana Immigration Department work permit information. Confirmed 2-year freelance/self-employment work permit category, requirements, and processing timeline.

records.claim: Oman issues employer-sponsored work visas for trades occupations including mechanics, electricians, AC technicians and plumbers. The employer applies for work visa approval, then issues an offer letter. Standard processing is 2-4 weeks. Salary range OMR 150-300/month for trades roles. Employer typically provides accommodation and food. Kafala partially reformed since 2021 — workers can change employers without sponsor permission.
records.methodology: Review of Oman Ministry of Labour work visa procedures. Confirmed employer-sponsored visa process for trades workers, salary ranges, and 2021 Kafala reform status.
